about: Per-model calibration file (feedback W37). Parameters: AN Table 2 plus π and ξ of the draft, not yet re-calibrated for bbr. Targets: AN's value and the site's value on each sample; role as decided on 27 Nov 2026 (D6, W48): spread and D/N targeted, ROE a check, the rest reported or external. 'decided' fields are filled by the calibration chat as Arthur decides. Default sample: up to date (W47); 1959–2012 for replication only.

pi_stage1.about: Stage 1 of the calibration of π (bubble survival, decision D7): the annual frequency of systemic banking or financial crises, crises started / years observed, and 1 − frequency. A burst of the model's bubble is not one-to-one with a measured crisis: these are inputs, not a calibration.
